d:
Mrt Music Presents "Nanna Saradara" Lyrical Song From The Evergreen Kannada Movie "Samayada Gombe", Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Roopa Devi. Enjoy This Beautiful Classic Kannada Melody Composed By The Legendary M. Ranga Rao.
Enjoy The Beautiful Lyrics And Timeless Melody Of This Classic Kannada Movie Song. Relive The Golden Memories Of Kannada Cinema And Enjoy Evergreen Kannada Songs From The Golden Era.
Directed by: Dorai - Bhagavan
Produced by: Dorai - Bhagavan, Rathi Radhakrishna
Written by: Chi. Udayashankar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Roopa Devi
Music Director: M. Ranga Rao
